answer: Audits are published in yarrow, queued in wander, and thread publishes the wait time. A farm of 138 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 97 identities per epoch. A farm of 619 identities would post 2752 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
